record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not

The query is a small, neutral coumarin (MW 192, one phenol, one methoxy, logD 1.39, TPSA 59.7) and lacks the multiple phenolic groups, sugar moieties, charge, and high molecular weight of the low-F polyphenols in the records, so those low-F outcomes have limited transferability.
The physicochemical prior for the query is favorable for F >= 20%, and there is no affirmative threshold-relevant evidence of F < 20% for this specific scaffold.

evidence_gaps: No direct oral bioavailability measurement for the query molecule in the supplied records.
No human or rat PK data for scopoletin itself; transfer from flavone/anthocyanin/flavonolignan/curcumin contexts is indirect.
First-pass conjugation of the single phenol and any lactone metabolism are not quantified.
Dose, formulation, and species effects on the query's oral exposure are unknown.
